domain.name: Creative / Generative Media
domain.description: Tools that generate or remix art, music, video, or 3D scenes — the agent's output *is* the product, not just a means to an action.

governance.name: Full Autonomy
governance.description: The agent acts unsupervised within its declared authority band — no per-action human gate.

latency.name: Interactive (sub-second)
latency.description: Conversational, turn-based UI latency — the user waits for one reply, not a stream of frames.

pitch: A creative / generative media governed by full autonomy, operating at interactive (sub-second) latency.
